t: Forge Steel spring clamp set offers an efficient, reliable clamping solution in workshops, garages, and on job sites. The 6-piece kit includes two each of 4", 6", and 9" clamps, for quickly and securely holding materials across various trade and DIY tasks. Featuring strong, durable jaws and powerful springs, the clamps provide a firm 14kg clamping force during woodworking, assembly, and fabrication projects. Pivoting tips ensure even pressure distribution, while the dual-injection handles deliver a comfortable, secure grip during prolonged use.
